purpose: Record OS/runtime facilities added while bringing the CPython-derived JetLang standard library to Green Gate. After the first in-guest stdlib PASS, remove/disable candidates one at a time and rerun qualification before deciding they are required.

policy.baseline: keep during bring-up until JETOS_STDLIB_QUALIFICATION=PASS is observed in a current-revision guest
policy.minimization: after baseline PASS, test one candidate removal at a time and keep only dependencies whose removal causes a reproducible qualification regression
policy.jetlang_changes: do not compensate in JetLang for missing ordinary Linux/POSIX facilities during baseline qualification

early_userspace.name: libgcc_s.so.1
early_userspace.reason: glibc dlopen dependency for thread cancellation/exit/unwinding
